Usage: agentcage cage create [OPTIONS] [CONFIG_POS]

  Build images, generate quadlets, install, and start a new cage.

  The config may be given positionally (`agentcage create ./cage.yaml`) or with
  -c (`agentcage create -c ./cage.yaml`).

Options:
  -c, --config PATH      Path to the cage config (cage.yaml). May also be given
                         positionally.
  -s, --set-secret TEXT  Set a secret (KEY=VALUE or KEY to prompt). Repeatable.
  --no-cache             Force a full image rebuild (ignore podman's layer
                         cache).
  --pull                 Force re-pull of the base image from the registry.
  --time                 Echo per-phase wall times and print a summary on
                         completion.
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
